description: Create a space (omit `space`; `name` required) or change one (name, icon, color, hidden). A new space gets the app's default task section. Never hand-write space JSON: this goes through the app's space model, validator and writer, stamps modifiedAt (epoch ms) so the app picks the change up, and keeps fields it does not know. A change the app would not load is refused (code space-invalid, with each issue's path). dry_run:true returns the space as it would be written.

color.description:
Colour as `#RRGGBB`, `#AARRGGBB` or the ARGB integer; an empty string
clears it.

dry_run.description: Validate and report the space as it would be written, writing nothing.

hidden.description: Hide the space from the sidebar.

icon.description: Icon name; an empty string clears it.

name.description:
The name. On a built-in space (id `default-*`) this sets its custom
name, as the app's rename does. The slug and file never change.

space.description:
The space to change (id, slug or name). Omit to create a space, which
then needs `name`.

name: set_space
